mapper.select: SELECT r.exam_reviewer_id AS examReviewerId, r.assessment_execution_id AS assessmentExecutionId, x.exam_id AS examId, r.reviewer_user_id AS reviewerUserId, u.user_name AS reviewerName, u.user_code AS reviewerCode, x.organization_id AS reviewerOrganizationId, org.org_name AS reviewerOrganizationName, r.assignment_source AS assignmentSource FROM sts_exam_reviewer r JOIN sts_assessment_execution x ON x.assessment_execution_id = r.assessment_execution_id AND x.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN us_sys_user u ON u.user_id = r.reviewer_user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sts_org_organization org ON org.organization_id = x.organization_id AND org.deleted = 0 WHERE r.assessment_execution_id = #{assessmentExecutionId} ORDER BY r.exam_reviewer_id ASC
